name: A Wish Come True
source:
Bella is a 19 year old university student. She lives at home with her dad.
Bella is not very popular at school, she is practically invisible til everyone around her. This is mainly due to her oversized appearance. She is overweight, meek, quiet, introverted and innocent.
The only friend she has is her childhood friend, Andrew.

At the end of their first year at university, Bella goes to visit her Grandmother for the summer. It quickly proves to be a life altering summer for Bella.
Her grandmother reveals that the women of their family curry favor with the Welsh goddess of change. Her grandmother suggests, that Bella seeks out the aid of the goddess. And so bella does. The next morning, Bella awakes to a startling sight. Her former pear shaped body has been transformed into an hourglass figure. A slim waist, broad hips and massive breasts.
Upon returning home, Bella soon realizes that the world is now treating her very different.
Where will this change take her? That's up to the player.
Is this the change she wanted? Only time will tell.
